blurb: E-FishinSea operates out of Rudee Inlet in Virginia Beach. They offer full-day offshore charters targeting Tuna, Marlin, Mahi Mahi, and Wahoo. Inshore and nearshore trips are available as full-day, 3/4-day, or half-day targeting species like Cobia, Spanish Mackerel, King Mackerel, Bluefish, and Spadefish.
